content_metadata.description: In this scene, Oisin, a data scientist at the CeADAR center, provides a comprehensive introduction to deep learning. He discusses its popularity, various applications, and the concept of 'opaque' data, highlighting the capabilities and significance of deep learning in handling complex data types.

scenes.contextualRelevance: This scene serves to inform the audience about deep learning, its importance, and its applications in modern technology.

narrativeProgression.description: Oisin introduces himself as a data scientist at the CeADAR center.
Oisin states he'll be talking about deep learning, covering interesting application areas and providing a brief overview of the technology itself.
Oisin begins his introduction to deep learning.
Oisin defines deep learning and explains why it has become so popular in recent years.
Oisin moves on to discuss what deep learning can do.
Oisin shifts his focus to image recognition as a key application of deep learning.
Oisin transitions to discussing Google's AlphaGo and its accomplishments in the game of Go.
Oisin describes another interesting application of deep learning in mitosis detection (identifying cancer cells in microscope slides).
Oisin contrasts traditional machine learning approaches with deep learning, highlighting how deep learning can automatically extract features from data.
Oisin introduces the concept of 'opaque' data and explains why deep learning is well-suited for analyzing such data.
Oisin introduces his colleague Aditya, who will continue the discussion.

scenes.title: Oisin's Introduction to Deep Learning

climax.description: The scene provides a detailed overview of deep learning, setting the stage for an understanding of its impact and importance.
